item_short_desc: Rothco's GI .30 & .50 Caliber Ammo Cans are the perfect storage solution for firearm enthusiasts. These rugged containers are not only ideal for organizing and transporting ammunition but also essential survival supplies. Featuring a collapsible handle, they offer efficient on-the-go carry and easy storage. The hinged lid with tension clamp closure ensures that your gear or ammo remains securely in place, providing peace of mind during transport.
